title: Insights into decohered critical states using an exact solution to matchgate circuits with Pauli noise
summary: The fate of non-trivial many-body states subject to decoherence is of both fundamental and practical interest. Here, we demonstrate a new analytic technique that allows for an exact treatment of dynamics of observables in matchgate circuits subject to arbitrary Pauli noise. We use this to obtain new insights on how decoherence influences critical ground states, focusing on the 1D transverse field Ising model subject to local Markovian Pauli noise.
